name: @papercusp/dock-workbench
description: Host-agnostic dockview workbench shell: panel registry, logical layout schema, adapters, pluggable persistence, and React DockWorkspace.

scripts.typecheck: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { dirname, resolve } = require('node:path'); const manifestPath = require.resolve('@typescript/native/package.json'); const compiler = resolve(dirname(manifestPath), require(manifestPath).bin.tsc); process.exit(spawnSync(process.execPath, [compiler, '--noEmit', '-p', 'tsconfig.json'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1)"
